shape: a small everyday annoyance someone causes now, seen from the day it stops

slides.text: one day the television won't be blaring the five o'clock news at volume forty-five, and you'll [[hate the quiet]].

caption:
my grandma always turned it up so high the floorboards shook.
it meant she was in her armchair, right where she belonged.
send this to a cousin who sat on the rug next to you.

#grandma #grandparents #grandmashouse
alt: A single slide post about missing the loud television at a grandparent's house once it goes quiet.
hook_options: one day the television won't be blaring the five o'clock news at volume forty-five
one day nobody will ask three times if you ate lunch before eleven in the morning
one day nobody will wrap your birthday money in five layers of taped newspaper
